name: Six-cup assembly
description: Six interchangeable cups in three layers. IDs identify assembly slots, not physical cup identities.

objects.placement_instructions: Place a cup in bottom left with its opening facing down, supported by table.
Place a cup in bottom center with its opening facing down, supported by table.
Place a cup in bottom right with its opening facing down, supported by table.
Place a cup in middle left with its opening facing up, supported by bottom_left and bottom_center.
Place a cup in middle right with its opening facing up, supported by bottom_center and bottom_right.
Place a cup in top center with its opening facing down, supported by middle_left and middle_right.

steps.instructions: Place three bottom cups with openings facing down on the table.
Keep the bottom layer and add two cups with openings facing up, each bridging adjacent bottom cups.
Keep both earlier layers and add one top cup with its opening facing down, bridging both middle cups.
